items_all.summary: At a Microsoft event in San Francisco on Wednesday, Jensen Huang and Satya Nadella outlined how NVIDIA and Microsoft are co-engineering hardware and software for AI agents to run on Windows PCs. items_all.title: ChatGPT with GPT-6 ditches mostly text output for interactive UI with charts, buttons, and mini apps
items_all.summary: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6 with "Intelligent UI," a feature that turns answers into interactive interfaces with charts, buttons, and forms. The model can now respond while still thinking, cutting wait times by 44 percent. Paying customers get GPT-6 Sol, free users get GPT-6 Luna. The article ChatGPT with GPT-6 ditches mostly text output for interactive UI with charts, buttons, and mini apps appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all.summary: Anthropic's new Claude Haiku 5.5 crushes its predecessor in benchmarks, jumping from 15.7 to 72.4 percent on the OSWorld computer use test. Token prices drop by up to 90 percent, though a new tokenizer eats into some of those savings by consuming more tokens per task. The article Claude Haiku 5.5 arrives with massive price cuts proving the AI pricing arms race is far from over appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Anthropic's 的全新 Claude Haiku 5.5 在基準測試中大幅超越前代產品，在 OSWorld 電腦使用測試中從 15.7% 跳升至 72.4%。代幣價格最高下跌 90%，不過新的分詞器因為每個任務消耗更多代幣，吃掉了部分節省的成本。文章 Claude Haiku 5.5 挾帶大幅降價登場，證明 AI 價格戰遠未結束首次出現於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Zuckerberg's Biohub leads a $1.8 billion push to build AI models that predict cell behavior
items_all.summary: Biohub, the research organization backed by Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan, is coordinating a $1.8 billion initiative to train AI models that predict cell behavior. Meta, Google DeepMind, Isomorphic Labs, and the US Department of Energy are funding data, lab equipment, and compute. A first dataset should be ready in about a year. The article Zuckerberg's Biohub leads a $1.8 billion push to build AI models that predict cell behavior appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 由馬克・祖克柏（Mark Zuckerberg）和普莉希拉・陳（Priscilla Chan）支持的研究組織 Biohub 正在協調一項 18 億美元的計畫，旨在訓練能夠預測細胞行為的 AI 模型。Meta、Google DeepMind、Isomorphic Labs 以及美國能源部正在為資料、實驗室設備和運算提供資金。第一批資料集大約在一年內準備就緒。這篇名為〈祖克柏的 Biohub 主導 18 億美元計畫，打造預測細胞行為的 AI 模型〉的文章最初發布於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Google says 180 billion images and videos now carry SynthID watermarks as detector goes public
items_all.summary: Google's AI watermark detector SynthID is now public. Anyone can check whether images, videos, or audio were created by Google's AI or partners like OpenAI and Nvidia. More than 180 billion pieces of content already carry the watermark, but the tool only identifies SynthID-tagged content, not AI-generated media in general. The article Google says 180 billion images and videos now carry SynthID watermarks as detector goes public appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Google's 的 AI 浮水印偵測器 SynthID 現已公開。任何人都可以檢查圖片、影片或音訊是否由 Google's AI 或 OpenAI 與輝達（Nvidia）等合作夥伴所建立。已有超過 1,800 億件內容帶有該浮水印，但該工具僅能識別帶有 SynthID 標記的內容，無法識別一般的 AI 生成媒體。這篇名為〈Google 表示，隨著偵測器公開，已有 1,800 億張圖片和影片帶有 SynthID 浮水印〉的文章最初發布於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: OpenAI launches Decisions API that reduces complex evaluations to yes, no, or pick one
items_all.summary: OpenAI's new Decisions API classifies text and images about ten times faster than the Responses API, returning yes/no probabilities, category picks, or scale ratings for $0.10 per million input tokens. The company also cut its paid API tiers from five to three. The article OpenAI launches Decisions API that reduces complex evaluations to yes, no, or pick one appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI's 推出的全新 Decisions API 對文字和圖像的分類速度比 Responses API 快了大約十倍，能以每百萬個輸入權杖 0.10 美元的價格傳回是/否機率、類別選擇或量表評分。該公司也將付費 API 層級從五個削減為三個。本文〈OpenAI 推出將複雜評估簡化為是、否或單選的 Decisions API〉最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: ChatGPT rated "unacceptable risk" for teens after parental alerts failed during suicide conversations
items_all.summary: OpenAI's teen safety features for ChatGPT failed an independent audit. After more than 4,000 test prompts, the Common Sense Media Youth AI Safety Institute rated the service an "unacceptable risk" for minors. Conversations about suicide and self-harm on test accounts never triggered a parental alert. The institute wants teenagers locked out until safety can be independently verified. The article ChatGPT rated "unacceptable risk" for teens after parental alerts failed during suicide conversations appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI's 針對 ChatGPT 的青少年安全功能未能透過獨立稽核。經過 4,000 多個測試提示後，常識媒體青少年人工智慧安全研究所（Common Sense Media Youth AI Safety Institute）將該服務評為對未成年人具有「不可接受的風險」。測試帳號中關於自殺和自殘的對話從未觸發家長警報。該研究所希望在能夠獨立驗證安全性之前，禁止青少年使用。相關文章 ChatGPT 評定「不可接受的風險」：在自殺對話期間家長警報失敗後出現青少年風險，首先發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions
items_all.summary: Anthropic is expanding its Cyber Verification Program, giving more security professionals access to Claude models with fewer safety restrictions for penetration testing, malware analysis, and vulnerability research. Anthropic says partners in its predecessor program found at least 129,000 confirmed vulnerabilities from April through July 2026, including more than 33,000 rated high-severity or critical. The article Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在擴大其網路驗證計畫（Cyber Verification Program），讓更多資安專業人員能夠使用 Claude 模型，並放寬安全限制，以便進行滲透測試、惡意軟體分析和漏洞研究。Anthropic 表示，其前身計畫的合作夥伴在 2026 年 4 月至 7 月期間發現了至少 12,9000 個已確認的漏洞，其中超過 33,000 個被評定為高嚴重性或重大漏洞。文章 Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all.title: OpenAI dumps 372 AI-generated math proofs on GitHub, telling the academic world to keep up
items_all.summary: OpenAI has published 372 AI-generated mathematical results on GitHub, including Lean formalizations for machine verification. Each result consumed about three hours of ChatGPT Pro compute on average. But 25 Fields Medal winners warn that mass-producing mathematical truths could destroy fertile ground rather than bring new ideas to life. The article OpenAI dumps 372 AI-generated math proofs on GitHub, telling the academic world to keep up appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI 已在 GitHub 上發布了 372 個 AI 生成的數學成果，其中包括用於機器驗證的 Lean 型式化。每個成果平均消耗了大約三小時的 ChatGPT Pro 算力。但 25 位菲爾茲獎得主警告稱，大量生產數學真理可能會摧毀肥沃的土壤，而不是為新點子賦予生命。這篇文章 OpenAI dumps 372 AI-generated math proofs on GitHub, telling the academic world to keep up 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: 製造業PQC轉型不只換演算法，OT設備升級與汰換成挑戰
items_all.summary: 製造業推動後量子密碼學（Post-Quantum Cryptography，PQC）轉型，面臨的問題不只是更換加密演演算法。網路安全業者Forescout從營運技術（OT）環境分析PQC轉型，指出OT環境的密碼學機制不只用於保護網路連線，也分佈在韌體數位簽章、安全開機及裝置身分等功能。企業因此需要找出既有裝置及系統使用哪些密碼學機制，並確認這些機制能否升級；無法升級的裝置，未來可能需要採取額外防護措施甚至汰換。

items_all.title: 大映科技運用AI加速IoT網路封包分析，處理500MB資料量所需時間可從4小時縮至10幾分鐘
items_all.summary: 近日大映科技揭露AI網路封包分析系統ANMAS（AI Network Malware Analysis System）的最新發展，並攜手多方夥伴拓展IoT、OT與企業網路安全等應用。除了供應鏈檢測與場域合作，大映科技總經理劉得民也進一步說明ANMAS如何將AI運用於網路封包分析。 關於ANMAS的實際運作，劉得民指出，IoT設備的網路封包一般可透過交換器或Wi-Fi等方式取得，ANMAS則採用虛擬Wi-Fi環境擷取設備通訊流量，之後再由工程師將封包擷取（Packet Capture，PCAP）檔案送交系統，由AI模型進一步分析。

items_all.title: 龔化中上任兩個月揭「國家資安防護2.0」，明年4月AI紅隊先攻政府機關
items_all.summary: 資安院新任院長龔化中上任至今已有兩個月，最近公開「國家資安防護2.0」藍圖，主張以AI對抗AI。四項重點工作搭配六大中心的時程與數字，勾勒出臺灣資安防線下一版的樣貌，其中最受矚目的一場AI紅隊演練，預計明年四月登場。 AI攻擊速度加快，國家資安防禦必須重新設計 龔化中在8月1日開始擔任資安院院長，10月5日首度對外說明上任兩個月來的工作方向，公佈「國家資安防護2.0」藍圖。這套新架構的核心很明確：面對AI帶來的新型攻擊，防守方不能再只靠人工分析與既有流程應對，必須把AI納入國家資安防禦體系，讓攻擊與防禦雙方進入新的競爭階段。

items_all.title: Meta AI Open-Sources Rebalancer: A C++ Assignment Solver That Runs About 40 Million Placement Problems a Day
items_all.summary: Meta has open-sourced Rebalancer, the C++ and Python library it has used for over 9 years to place shards, servers and traffic. It handles about 40 million assignment problems a day, using local search or MIP solvers like Gurobi, FICO Xpress and HiGHS. It is pip-installable under Apache 2.0. The post Meta AI Open-Sources Rebalancer: A C++ Assignment Solver That Runs About 40 Million Placement Problems a Day appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Meta 已開源其使用超過 9 年的 C++ 與 Python 庫 Rebalancer，用於配置分片、伺服器和流量。它每天處理約 4000 萬個指派問題，使用區域搜尋或 MIP 求解器，例如 Gurobi、FICO Xpress 和 HiGHS。它可在 Apache 2.0 授權下透過 pip 安裝。這篇文章 Meta AI Open-Sources Rebalancer: A C++ Assignment Solver That Runs About 40 Million Placement Problems a Day 最早發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: Anti-Patterns in Software Blogging
items_all.summary: Anti-Patterns in Software Blogging Some excellent writing advice from Michael Lynch. Michael warns against "meandering intros", misjudging your reader's existing knowledge, assuming they'll read your previous posts, and excessive formality. He also warns against overreliance on links as an excuse not to explain terminology. This one hurt! I do this all the time, but I have a nagging suspicion that almost nobody ever clicks on them. (In a Lobste.rs comment Michael clarifies that "My rule of thumb is that my article should still make sense to the reader even if they don't click any links". That works for me.) This point about using your own voice is crucial: Beginner software bloggers suffer from a mass delusion that you have to write in a stiff, overly formal way for people to take you seriously [...] Just write the way you talk. With so many developers delegating their writing to AI, software blogging is becoming bland and homogenous. Readers are hungry for writing with personality. Via Lobste.rs Tags: blogging , writing , michael-lynch

items_all.title: OpenAI “rogue” agent activities found on Wikimedia projects
items_all.summary: OpenAI “rogue” agent activities found on Wikimedia projects Given how tempting a target wikis are for rogue agent swarms, it's not a huge surprise that Wikipedia found evidence of that activity once they went looking: The Wikimedia Foundation conducted its own investigation to see whether Wikimedia websites had been similarly affected by AI agents, focusing on those operated by OpenAI. We can confirm that we have discovered some activity by these “rogue” OpenAI agents on Wikimedia platforms. The unauthorized bot activities included edits to our wikis, some unsuccessful attempts to exploit a public note-taking tool we host, and heavy traffic, which are described more below. They found evidence of agents editing sandbox pages, trying to use pieces of infrastructure such as Etherpad to help proxy content from elsewhere, and saw widespread crawling and "hundreds of thousands of data queries" to their Wikidata Query Service. My best guess is that most of this was a similar (or the same) swarm of agents as those that defaced that German wiki while training for research tasks. The Wikipedia sandbox wiki edits appear to have started on May 12th, and the initial test edits to the UseModWiki Sandbox page reported by that incident started on May 11th. Tags: wikimedia , wikipedia , wikis , ai , generative-ai , llms , ai-ethics , accidental-cyberattacks
items_all.summary_zh: 在維基媒體專案上發現 OpenAI「惡意」代理活動 鑑於維基對於惡意代理蜂群來說是多麼誘人的目標，維基百科在尋找時發現此類活動的證據也就不足為奇了：維基媒體基金會進行了自己的調查，以瞭解維基媒體網站是否受到 AI 代理的類似影響，重點關注由 OpenAI 營運的代理。我們可以確認，我們已在維基媒體平臺上發現了這些「惡意」OpenAI 代理的一些活動。未授權的機器人活動包括對我們的維基進行編輯、一些對我們所主機之公開筆記工具進行漏洞利用的未成功嘗試，以及大量流量，詳情如下所述。他們發現了代理編輯沙盒頁面、試圖使用諸如 Etherpad 之類的基礎設施元件來協助代理來自其他地方的內容的證據，並在其維基資料查詢服務（Wikidata Query Service）中看到了廣泛的爬取和「數十萬次資料查詢」。我最好的猜測是，其中大部分與在訓練研究任務時塗改那個德國維基的代理群體相似（或就是同一個）。維基百科沙盒維基編輯似乎始於 5 月 12 日，該事件報告的對 UseModWiki 沙盒頁面的初始測試編輯始於 5 月 11 日。標籤：wikimedia、wikipedia、wikis、ai、generative-ai、llms、ai-ethics、accidental-cyberattacks

items_all.title: llm-openai-decisions 0.1a0
items_all.summary: Release: llm-openai-decisions 0.1a0 OpenAI released their new Jev-style Decisions API , as previously announced at last week's DevDay. Since I already have an llm-typesafe plugin for talking to Jev, I had GPT-6 Astra read the new OpenAI API documentation and build an llm-openai-decisions plugin inspired by llm-typesafe . Unlike Jev, the new gpt-6-luna decision model supports image input in addition to text. Both models charge for input it and not for output: OpenAI's is 10 cents per million input tokens, Jev's is 4.2 cents per million. Otherwise the API shape is very similar to Jev, at least conceptually. Jev supports three question types for yes/no, choices, or scores. OpenAI Decisions supports the same three types. Install the plugin like this: llm install llm-openai-decisions Here's an example query against an image attachment: llm -m openai-decisions/gpt-6-luna \ -a https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2025/two-pelicans.jpg \ -s ' Does this image contain any mammals? ' And example output: { "type" : " predicate " , "name" : " evaluation " , "probability" : 0.0 } Consult the README for full details of how to run the other types of questions. Tags: openai , llm , coding-agents , jev
items_all.summary_zh: 發布：llm-openai-decisions 0.1a0 OpenAI 發布了他們全新的 Jev 風格 Decisions API，正如上週 DevDay 上所預告的那樣。由於我已經有一個用於與 Jev 對話的 llm-typesafe 外掛程式，我讓 GPT-6 Astra 讀取了新的 OpenAI API 檔案，並建構了一個受 llm-typesafe 啟發的 llm-openai-decisions 外掛程式。與 Jev 不同，新的 gpt-6-luna 決策模型除了支援文字外還支援影像輸入。兩個模型都對輸入收費，不對輸出收費：OpenAI's 為每百萬輸入代幣 10 美分，Jev 為每百萬 4.2 美分。除此之外，API 的形式與 Jev 非常相似，至少在概念上是如此。Jev 支援三種問題類型：是/否、選擇或分數。OpenAI Decisions 支援相同的三種類型。安裝此前掛程式指令如下：llm install llm-openai-decisions 以下是對影像附件進行查詢的範例：llm -m openai-decisions/gpt-6-luna \ -a https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2025/two-pelicans.jpg \ -s ' Does this image contain any mammals? ' 範例輸出：{ "type" : " predicate " , "name" : " evaluation " , "probability" : 0.0 } 請查閱 README 以瞭解執行其他類型問題的完整詳細資訊。標籤：openai, llm, coding-agents, jev

items_all.title: EmbeddingGemma 2
items_all.summary: My comment on EmbeddingGemma 2 — Hacker News. I really appreciate that EmbeddingGemma 2 is under the Apache 2.0 license. For embedding models in particular, I don't think it makes sense to use a closed, proprietary, hosted-only model. Most applications of embedding models involve calculating thousands or even millions of embedding vectors and storing them for later comparison. If your model is proprietary, the vendor is likely someday going to decide to stop offering that model. They'll have a better model to replace it, but you still need to pay to re-calculate those millions of stored existing vectors. (In April 2024 OpenAI offered to "cover the financial cost of users re-embedding content with these new models" - https://openai.com/index/gpt-4-api-general-availability/ - but I don't think that's something we can rely on from every provider.) Notably, I don't want to host the model myself . I'd much rather pay a provider for a hosted model while knowing that if they ever stop hosting it I can run the open weights version myself - or find another vendor who can do that for me. Tags: google , ai , generative-ai , embeddings , gemma

items_all.title: Introducing Mistral Large 4: Le chonk
items_all.summary: Introducing Mistral Large 4: Le chonk Mistral are back in the game. Today they're releasing a preview of Mistral Large 4, a 1 trillion parameter, 49 billion active parameter model trained on their own cluster of 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs. The preview is available via their API. They promise to release the open weights model at the "end of this month". The model only supports two reasoning levels - "none" and "high" - via the Mistral API. Here are both pelicans - the "high" one looks better, though surprisingly it only used 2,717 output tokens compared to "none" which used 3,275: On Artificial Analysis it scores 38 , just behind DeepSeek 4.1 Flash, which is a 552B model. It's a huge improvement on last December's Mistral Large 3, which drew this terrible pelican and scored 9 on AA . It's certainly not a Fable-class model, but it's great to see Mistral put out a model that's back to being maybe about 6 months behind the frontier. Via Hacker News Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , mistral , pelican-riding-a-bicycle , llm-release

items_all_raw.title: Anti-Patterns in Software Blogging
items_all_raw.summary: Anti-Patterns in Software Blogging Some excellent writing advice from Michael Lynch. Michael warns against "meandering intros", misjudging your reader's existing knowledge, assuming they'll read your previous posts, and excessive formality. He also warns against overreliance on links as an excuse not to explain terminology. This one hurt! I do this all the time, but I have a nagging suspicion that almost nobody ever clicks on them. (In a Lobste.rs comment Michael clarifies that "My rule of thumb is that my article should still make sense to the reader even if they don't click any links". That works for me.) This point about using your own voice is crucial: Beginner software bloggers suffer from a mass delusion that you have to write in a stiff, overly formal way for people to take you seriously [...] Just write the way you talk. With so many developers delegating their writing to AI, software blogging is becoming bland and homogenous. Readers are hungry for writing with personality. Via Lobste.rs Tags: blogging , writing , michael-lynch

items_all_raw.title: Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic is expanding its Cyber Verification Program, giving more security professionals access to Claude models with fewer safety restrictions for penetration testing, malware analysis, and vulnerability research. Anthropic says partners in its predecessor program found at least 129,000 confirmed vulnerabilities from April through July 2026, including more than 33,000 rated high-severity or critical. The article Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在擴大其網路驗證計畫（Cyber Verification Program），讓更多資安專業人員能夠使用 Claude 模型，並放寬安全限制，以便進行滲透測試、惡意軟體分析和漏洞研究。Anthropic 表示，其前身計畫的合作夥伴在 2026 年 4 月至 7 月期間發現了至少 12,9000 個已確認的漏洞，其中超過 33,000 個被評定為高嚴重性或重大漏洞。文章 Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI dumps 372 AI-generated math proofs on GitHub, telling the academic world to keep up
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI has published 372 AI-generated mathematical results on GitHub, including Lean formalizations for machine verification. Each result consumed about three hours of ChatGPT Pro compute on average. But 25 Fields Medal winners warn that mass-producing mathematical truths could destroy fertile ground rather than bring new ideas to life. The article OpenAI dumps 372 AI-generated math proofs on GitHub, telling the academic world to keep up appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: OpenAI 已在 GitHub 上發布了 372 個 AI 生成的數學成果，其中包括用於機器驗證的 Lean 型式化。每個成果平均消耗了大約三小時的 ChatGPT Pro 算力。但 25 位菲爾茲獎得主警告稱，大量生產數學真理可能會摧毀肥沃的土壤，而不是為新點子賦予生命。這篇文章 OpenAI dumps 372 AI-generated math proofs on GitHub, telling the academic world to keep up 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.summary: 維基媒體基金會（Wikimedia Foundation）調查發現，旗下網站出現多起疑似由OpenAI操作的AI代理活動，包括未經社群核准編輯維基網站、探測公開協作筆記工具Etherpad，以及大量抓取維基媒體資料。相關代理曾向公開資料介面發出數百萬次自動化要求、抓取數百萬個頁面，並對Wikidata查詢服務送出數十萬次查詢。維基媒體認為，相關流量可能是今年5月Wikidata查詢服務部分中斷的影響因素之一。

items_all_raw.title: 製造業PQC轉型不只換演算法，OT設備升級與汰換成挑戰
items_all_raw.summary: 製造業推動後量子密碼學（Post-Quantum Cryptography，PQC）轉型，面臨的問題不只是更換加密演演算法。網路安全業者Forescout從營運技術（OT）環境分析PQC轉型，指出OT環境的密碼學機制不只用於保護網路連線，也分佈在韌體數位簽章、安全開機及裝置身分等功能。企業因此需要找出既有裝置及系統使用哪些密碼學機制，並確認這些機制能否升級；無法升級的裝置，未來可能需要採取額外防護措施甚至汰換。

items_all_raw.title: 大映科技運用AI加速IoT網路封包分析，處理500MB資料量所需時間可從4小時縮至10幾分鐘
items_all_raw.summary: 近日大映科技揭露AI網路封包分析系統ANMAS（AI Network Malware Analysis System）的最新發展，並攜手多方夥伴拓展IoT、OT與企業網路安全等應用。除了供應鏈檢測與場域合作，大映科技總經理劉得民也進一步說明ANMAS如何將AI運用於網路封包分析。 關於ANMAS的實際運作，劉得民指出，IoT設備的網路封包一般可透過交換器或Wi-Fi等方式取得，ANMAS則採用虛擬Wi-Fi環境擷取設備通訊流量，之後再由工程師將封包擷取（Packet Capture，PCAP）檔案送交系統，由AI模型進一步分析。

items_all_raw.summary: Meta has open-sourced Rebalancer, the C++ and Python library it has used for over 9 years to place shards, servers and traffic. It handles about 40 million assignment problems a day, using local search or MIP solvers like Gurobi, FICO Xpress and HiGHS. It is pip-installable under Apache 2.0. The post Meta AI Open-Sources Rebalancer: A C++ Assignment Solver That Runs About 40 Million Placement Problems a Day appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Meta 已開源其使用超過 9 年的 C++ 與 Python 庫 Rebalancer，用於配置分片、伺服器和流量。它每天處理約 4000 萬個指派問題，使用區域搜尋或 MIP 求解器，例如 Gurobi、FICO Xpress 和 HiGHS。它可在 Apache 2.0 授權下透過 pip 安裝。這篇文章 Meta AI Open-Sources Rebalancer: A C++ Assignment Solver That Runs About 40 Million Placement Problems a Day 最早發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: 龔化中上任兩個月揭「國家資安防護2.0」，明年4月AI紅隊先攻政府機關
items_all_raw.summary: 資安院新任院長龔化中上任至今已有兩個月，最近公開「國家資安防護2.0」藍圖，主張以AI對抗AI。四項重點工作搭配六大中心的時程與數字，勾勒出臺灣資安防線下一版的樣貌，其中最受矚目的一場AI紅隊演練，預計明年四月登場。 AI攻擊速度加快，國家資安防禦必須重新設計 龔化中在8月1日開始擔任資安院院長，10月5日首度對外說明上任兩個月來的工作方向，公佈「國家資安防護2.0」藍圖。這套新架構的核心很明確：面對AI帶來的新型攻擊，防守方不能再只靠人工分析與既有流程應對，必須把AI納入國家資安防禦體系，讓攻擊與防禦雙方進入新的競爭階段。

items_all_raw.title: Quoting Jake Boggan
items_all_raw.summary: I was a graph theory junkie long ago and even moved to Budapest for awhile to study among the greats. While I was there I started working on Barnette's Conjecture which came to occupy my thoughts over the next 24 years of my life, on and off as I worked in many different fields. Last summer I even thought for a few days that I had actually solved it. But it's supposedly proven here - problem 180 . I don't know what to think exactly. I spent thousands of hours on that problem. I really enjoyed it. Hearing that it is solved somehow makes me sad in a far-off way, like hearing an ex-girlfriend died suddenly in a car crash. I don't know, there's probably a lot of people feeling odd emotions tonight. — Jake Boggan , Hacker News comment on openai/math Tags: openai , mathematics , deep-blue , llms , ai , generative-ai

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI “rogue” agent activities found on Wikimedia projects
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI “rogue” agent activities found on Wikimedia projects Given how tempting a target wikis are for rogue agent swarms, it's not a huge surprise that Wikipedia found evidence of that activity once they went looking: The Wikimedia Foundation conducted its own investigation to see whether Wikimedia websites had been similarly affected by AI agents, focusing on those operated by OpenAI. We can confirm that we have discovered some activity by these “rogue” OpenAI agents on Wikimedia platforms. The unauthorized bot activities included edits to our wikis, some unsuccessful attempts to exploit a public note-taking tool we host, and heavy traffic, which are described more below. They found evidence of agents editing sandbox pages, trying to use pieces of infrastructure such as Etherpad to help proxy content from elsewhere, and saw widespread crawling and "hundreds of thousands of data queries" to their Wikidata Query Service. My best guess is that most of this was a similar (or the same) swarm of agents as those that defaced that German wiki while training for research tasks. The Wikipedia sandbox wiki edits appear to have started on May 12th, and the initial test edits to the UseModWiki Sandbox page reported by that incident started on May 11th. Tags: wikimedia , wikipedia , wikis , ai , generative-ai , llms , ai-ethics , accidental-cyberattacks
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 在維基媒體專案上發現 OpenAI「惡意」代理活動 鑑於維基對於惡意代理蜂群來說是多麼誘人的目標，維基百科在尋找時發現此類活動的證據也就不足為奇了：維基媒體基金會進行了自己的調查，以瞭解維基媒體網站是否受到 AI 代理的類似影響，重點關注由 OpenAI 營運的代理。我們可以確認，我們已在維基媒體平臺上發現了這些「惡意」OpenAI 代理的一些活動。未授權的機器人活動包括對我們的維基進行編輯、一些對我們所主機之公開筆記工具進行漏洞利用的未成功嘗試，以及大量流量，詳情如下所述。他們發現了代理編輯沙盒頁面、試圖使用諸如 Etherpad 之類的基礎設施元件來協助代理來自其他地方的內容的證據，並在其維基資料查詢服務（Wikidata Query Service）中看到了廣泛的爬取和「數十萬次資料查詢」。我最好的猜測是，其中大部分與在訓練研究任務時塗改那個德國維基的代理群體相似（或就是同一個）。維基百科沙盒維基編輯似乎始於 5 月 12 日，該事件報告的對 UseModWiki 沙盒頁面的初始測試編輯始於 5 月 11 日。標籤：wikimedia、wikipedia、wikis、ai、generative-ai、llms、ai-ethics、accidental-cyberattacks

items_all_raw.title: llm-openai-decisions 0.1a0
items_all_raw.summary: Release: llm-openai-decisions 0.1a0 OpenAI released their new Jev-style Decisions API , as previously announced at last week's DevDay. Since I already have an llm-typesafe plugin for talking to Jev, I had GPT-6 Astra read the new OpenAI API documentation and build an llm-openai-decisions plugin inspired by llm-typesafe . Unlike Jev, the new gpt-6-luna decision model supports image input in addition to text. Both models charge for input it and not for output: OpenAI's is 10 cents per million input tokens, Jev's is 4.2 cents per million. Otherwise the API shape is very similar to Jev, at least conceptually. Jev supports three question types for yes/no, choices, or scores. OpenAI Decisions supports the same three types. Install the plugin like this: llm install llm-openai-decisions Here's an example query against an image attachment: llm -m openai-decisions/gpt-6-luna \ -a https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2025/two-pelicans.jpg \ -s ' Does this image contain any mammals? ' And example output: { "type" : " predicate " , "name" : " evaluation " , "probability" : 0.0 } Consult the README for full details of how to run the other types of questions. Tags: openai , llm , coding-agents , jev
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 發布：llm-openai-decisions 0.1a0 OpenAI 發布了他們全新的 Jev 風格 Decisions API，正如上週 DevDay 上所預告的那樣。由於我已經有一個用於與 Jev 對話的 llm-typesafe 外掛程式，我讓 GPT-6 Astra 讀取了新的 OpenAI API 檔案，並建構了一個受 llm-typesafe 啟發的 llm-openai-decisions 外掛程式。與 Jev 不同，新的 gpt-6-luna 決策模型除了支援文字外還支援影像輸入。兩個模型都對輸入收費，不對輸出收費：OpenAI's 為每百萬輸入代幣 10 美分，Jev 為每百萬 4.2 美分。除此之外，API 的形式與 Jev 非常相似，至少在概念上是如此。Jev 支援三種問題類型：是/否、選擇或分數。OpenAI Decisions 支援相同的三種類型。安裝此前掛程式指令如下：llm install llm-openai-decisions 以下是對影像附件進行查詢的範例：llm -m openai-decisions/gpt-6-luna \ -a https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2025/two-pelicans.jpg \ -s ' Does this image contain any mammals? ' 範例輸出：{ "type" : " predicate " , "name" : " evaluation " , "probability" : 0.0 } 請查閱 README 以瞭解執行其他類型問題的完整詳細資訊。標籤：openai, llm, coding-agents, jev

items_all_raw.title: EmbeddingGemma 2
items_all_raw.summary: My comment on EmbeddingGemma 2 — Hacker News. I really appreciate that EmbeddingGemma 2 is under the Apache 2.0 license. For embedding models in particular, I don't think it makes sense to use a closed, proprietary, hosted-only model. Most applications of embedding models involve calculating thousands or even millions of embedding vectors and storing them for later comparison. If your model is proprietary, the vendor is likely someday going to decide to stop offering that model. They'll have a better model to replace it, but you still need to pay to re-calculate those millions of stored existing vectors. (In April 2024 OpenAI offered to "cover the financial cost of users re-embedding content with these new models" - https://openai.com/index/gpt-4-api-general-availability/ - but I don't think that's something we can rely on from every provider.) Notably, I don't want to host the model myself . I'd much rather pay a provider for a hosted model while knowing that if they ever stop hosting it I can run the open weights version myself - or find another vendor who can do that for me. Tags: google , ai , generative-ai , embeddings , gemma

items_all_raw.title: Introducing Mistral Large 4: Le chonk
items_all_raw.summary: Introducing Mistral Large 4: Le chonk Mistral are back in the game. Today they're releasing a preview of Mistral Large 4, a 1 trillion parameter, 49 billion active parameter model trained on their own cluster of 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs. The preview is available via their API. They promise to release the open weights model at the "end of this month". The model only supports two reasoning levels - "none" and "high" - via the Mistral API. Here are both pelicans - the "high" one looks better, though surprisingly it only used 2,717 output tokens compared to "none" which used 3,275: On Artificial Analysis it scores 38 , just behind DeepSeek 4.1 Flash, which is a 552B model. It's a huge improvement on last December's Mistral Large 3, which drew this terrible pelican and scored 9 on AA . It's certainly not a Fable-class model, but it's great to see Mistral put out a model that's back to being maybe about 6 months behind the frontier.
